subject: mooring posts on a silver-blue harbor
pose: posts low, distant boat near horizon
art_direction: 平静小港的低处木桩映在银蓝水面，远方无字小船只有一笔浅影。
visible_description: 平静小港的低处木桩映在银蓝水面，远方无字小船只有一笔浅影。
composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Leave the upper roughly 20% naturally quiet for a lock-screen clock, using open sky, mist, water, a wall or a gentle color field; do not draw any clock or UI. Do not put essential faces or details at the extreme sides. Use a full-bleed rectangular composition, no border, no circular frame. Let scale, texture, atmosphere and beautiful lighting create the impact. Preserve clarity instead of filling every area with ornament.
creative_direction: Photograph a still harbor in light rain, placing a few weathered mooring posts low in the frame. Silver-blue water holds their soft reflections, while one distant unmarked boat becomes a pale shape near the low horizon. Keep rain almost invisible except for small water dimples. Broad overcast light creates quiet distance without foggy heaviness or busy harbor equipment. Vertical 1024x1536. Reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet negative space, keeping detail lower in the composition. Original peaceful image, no text, branding, or watermark.
